eft_firmware.notes: duty 0 -> no firing at all with or without bursts (inc == 0 forces sd_fire_cycle false); bursts only redistribute and add firings while the controller is heating. The PID loop corrects the power error within its thermal time constant; criterion B allows degradation during the test. P-E2: accept a falling edge only if /ZCD is still low 50 us later (level qualification); a window gate (9-11 ms) was also modelled and is worse because 5 kHz burst edges fall inside any window.
